recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. FHIR-29267 is satisfied in current source; any further policy work around Substance being instance-only should be handled under FHIR-48405 or another dedicated issue key.
issue_request: FHIR-29267 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested removal of the Substance.instance backbone element, moving instance.expiry and instance.quantity to Substance.expiry and Substance.quantity, with former instance identifiers represented by Substance.identifier.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in commit ce7d94f0984ae009254c17c60df0d81252aafac0, which cited FHIR#29267. R4B compatibility work under FHIR-31526 temporarily reverted Substance toward the R4 structure, but beb040d0608727a093902f91d4e3d6675f0c33f6 restored the intended R5 source model with root-level expiry and quantity.
additional_context: O&O 2020-10-26 HCP minutes confirm the same motion and 7-0-6 vote. Later FHIR-48405 removed the R5 boolean Substance.instance flag and made Substance instance-only for R6, reinforcing that no Substance.instance element should be restored for this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Substance is active in source/fhir.ini; source/substance/structuredefinition-Substance.xml defines Substance.expiry and Substance.quantity as root elements and has no Substance.instance element; source/substance/bundle-Substance-search-params.xml uses the root paths for expiry and quantity. Remaining Substance.instance strings are migration notes in fhir.ini, not active element definitions.
